title: workspace
subHeroTitle: Organizations, spaces, and granular keycard security
subHeroDesc: KeilHQ unifies work around structured company Organizations and project Spaces. Secure your directory, billing, and resources with strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

sections.title: Structured company buildings and project spaces
sections.desc: Scope your entire company into a single Organization that owns billing and settings, and spin up individual project Spaces for tasks, channels, and Motion docs.

gridItems.title: 🏢 Organization Structure
gridItems.desc: The Organization represents your entire company (e.g. Acme Corp), owning the billing subscriptions, member directories, and global preferences.

gridItems.title: 🚪 Project Spaces Rooms
gridItems.desc: Spaces represent project workspaces (e.g. #engineering) containing their own tasks, chat channels, and Motion document trees.

gridItems.title: 🚪 Default Space Lobby
gridItems.desc: A Default Space acts like a lobby. When new employees join, they are automatically placed here to start communicating immediately.

gridItems.title: 🛠 Platform Admin Panels
gridItems.desc: Hidden operator controls allow system operators to manage billing rates, turn feature flags on/off, and monitor platform health.

sections.title: Role-Based Access Control and security safety guards
sections.desc: Control member access at both Organization and Space levels with granular roles. Enforce safety rules that prevent accidental administrator lockouts.

gridItems.title: 👑 Organization Roles
gridItems.desc: Configure company-wide permissions: Owners manage subscriptions; Admins manage users/spaces; Members access permitted workspaces.

gridItems.title: 🔑 Space-Level Roles
gridItems.desc: Grant local permissions: Space Admins edit settings/delete content; Managers create tasks/edit docs; Members post messages/comments.

gridItems.title: 🚫 Self-Demotion Guards
gridItems.desc: The security engine blocks you from changing or deleting your own admin role, ensuring a room is never left with zero administrators.

gridItems.title: 🛡 Peer Protection Rules
gridItems.desc: Standard Space Admins cannot demote or remove other Space Admins. Only a global Org Owner or Admin can execute demotions.

capabilitiesDesc: KeilHQ is built around Organisations and Spaces. Your sidebar, settings, and onboarding flow keep every task, doc, and message scoped to the right context automatically.
checklistTitle: Enterprise-grade keycard security and space setup
checklistDesc: Control access across all company domains and project workspaces automatically.
checklistItems: Organization & Space Directories: Building-level company accounts owning billing, paired with room-level workspaces scoping task/chat content.,
Company Role Tiers: Configure company-wide access permissions for Owners (subscription billing control), Admins, and Members.,
Space Role Tiers: Configure room-level access permissions for Space Admins (renaming, hard deletes), Managers (tasks & docs), and Members.,
Self-Demotion Blocker: System rules blocking you from deleting your own admin state, protecting workspaces against zero-admin lockouts.,
Platform Operator controls: Hidden operator panel monitoring overall system health, adjusting rate limits, and toggling account feature flags.
